title: How many obligor groups from the monitored book will reach the watch list in the year to 30 September 2027
subdomain: credit-scoring-pd-modeling (early-warning and watch-list monitoring of corporate obligor groups)
prompt_shape: 05 (allocation to a fixed total): the caseload allocated over the five exposure bands, each band with the groups it holds, their committed exposure, the groups the September early-warning run flagged, the expected arrivals and the committed exposure they are expected to bring, with a total row
